items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Colatina Open 2026 é 3º Campeonato Oficial de Colatina. Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IIIColatinaOpen2026/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em participará; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Colatina Open 2026 is the 3rd Official Colatina Competition. We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IIIColatinaOpen2026/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience!

items.information: # REGISTRO **A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:** * Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, [leia o regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); * Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal; * Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; * Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$25,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**; * Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**; * Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (renan.cunha20@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org); * Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. # REGISTRATION **The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:** * If this is your first time competing, [read the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by [watching this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-81VRLyYhbQ); * Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian; * Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; * Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Westend Mega NxNxN Berlin 2026
items.information: **Deutsch** **Berlin ist Mega!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, im schönen Bezirk Charlottenburg, Ortsteil Westend. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue direkt an der Stadtautobahn mitten in Berlin, tolle Disziplinen und vor allem großzügige Cutoffs, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Zeitplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** **Berlin is Mega!** We warmly invite you to the Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, in the beautiful Westend part of the district Charlottenburg. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you there. You can expect a beautiful venue right next to the city highway in the heart of Berlin, great disciplines, and, above all, generous cutoffs, a motivated organizing team, and much more. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.information: ### For the first time the Western Championship PBQ will be held at multiple locations on the same day! Please read the "[Westerns PBQ FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsPBQChampionshipSanta2026#71056-western-pbq-championship-faq)" for more information. ### This is the competition site for the SANTA CLARA Location. You can find the other [locations here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsPBQChampionshipSanta2026#71055-western-pbq-locations). Competitors at the SCU location will be required to fill out and submit [SCU's liability form](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aN52eBqg3IX2KroaLRDrzmlDiXyRp0Yg/view?usp=sharing) prior to competing. This will be collected at a later time. This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ2NjQzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cf643f8826077f011ac9001e0e28d1f7cb4b8b45/WesternsLogo%20-%20Edited.png) - Current SCU students are eligible for a 66% discount. They must pay the full $18 fee in order to register for the competition but will be refunded 66% after they attend the competition. Professor Marks (rmarks@scu.edu) will verify SCU student status upon receiving an email from the competitor's @scu.edu account.
